description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), causes [Imperil Wind 20%] and [Imperil Fire 20%] for 25 seconds, grants [Awoken Thief], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Fire, Wind)] and [Twin Anchor Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Thief
description.text: Thief abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Thief abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Fire, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Wind] after using a Fire/Wind ability

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Twin Anchor Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Twin Anchor after using three Thief abilities

description.name: Twin Anchor
description.text: Causes [Imperil Wind 10%] for 15 seconds and [Imperil Fire 10%] for 15 seconds
